description: This file defines the 'Menu' class within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Controller\Common' namespace. The class is responsible for generating the data for the site navigation menu, including category hierarchy and product counts, and rendering it via a view template. It loads language resources, models for categories and products, and constructs a nested menu structure based on categories and subcategories.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Controller class responsible for generating and rendering the navigation menu.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads language and models, constructs categories hierarchy with product counts, and returns the rendered menu view.
